headline: Ex-OpenAI employee accused of spying for Saudi Arabia
standfirst: Court records allege a former staffer planted a device with foreign government support.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A court filing claims a former OpenAI worker planted a device to aid Saudi interests.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The allegations emerged in a legal dispute involving the company and the former employee.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It raises serious security concerns about how AI companies protect their private technology.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: We are waiting to see if the Saudi government responds to requests for comment.

caption:
A former OpenAI employee is facing allegations of planting a device with support from Saudi Arabia.

Court documents suggest the worker received backing from the Saudi government during the incident. This case highlights the intense security measures surrounding top AI labs. We are still waiting for an official response from Saudi officials regarding these claims.
